assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished leader diplomacy illustration for a Civilization V fantasy civilization, the Department of Lost Things. Create a memorable singular character: Chief Registrar Nobody is a HEADLESS supernatural registrar, not a human man. A very tall thin hovering midnight-blue bureaucratic frock coat with a high EMPTY collar; no head, no skull, no hidden human face, no glowing eye. The empty collar and an antique pair of spectacles floating above it make an unmistakable whimsical silhouette. Two detached ivory gloves: one holding a giant scarlet wax-seal stamp, the other presenting a small lost brass key tied to a paper claim tag. His coat trails paper ticket stubs; an ancient oak counter fills the foreground. Towering orderly lost-property cabinets, hanging umbrellas, clocks and forgotten parcels recede into a nocturnal indigo archive, with cold blue supernatural light and one crimson desk lamp. Mood dryly comic, uncanny and dignified, not horror. Painterly lavish historical strategy-game concept art, hand-painted textures, expressive shapes, deep shadows, no photoreal actor. Landscape composition, approximately 4:3, centered waist-up silhouette at a low desk, empty collar around upper center with plenty of clear space, strong readable figure for later circular portrait crop. No words, no numbers, no letters, no watermark, no UI, no border. Keep all anatomy intentionally headless and hands readable.
